# Tierline

> Learn the four data center tiers, from basic capacity to fault tolerant, with an interactive tier explorer and training on tier infrastructure, design and continuity.

Tierline (https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Tier Infrastructure, Design Fundamentals, Disaster Recovery & Continuity, Power Systems & Electrical training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Tier Infrastructure Fundamentals](https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/tier-infrastructure-fundamentals): $280.99 per seat, 8 Hours, Uptime Institute Tier Framework. Understand and assess TIER I–IV infrastructure without the formal certification track. Enroll: https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/tier-infrastructure-fundamentals?buy=849
- [Data Center Design Fundamentals](https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-design-fundamentals): $312.99 per seat, 8 Hours, ANSI/TIA-942. Design data center facilities that scale — from site selection to redundancy strategy. Enroll: https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-design-fundamentals?buy=842
- [Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity](https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/disaster-recovery-business-continuity): $307.99 per seat, 8 Hours, RTO/RPO Frameworks. Design resilient infrastructure and DR plans that survive real failures — not just tabletop exercises. Enroll: https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/disaster-recovery-business-continuity?buy=844
- [Power Systems & Electrical Fundamentals](https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/power-systems-electrical-fundamentals): $303.99 per seat, 8 Hours, NFPA 70E. Master data center electrical infrastructure — from utility interconnection to UPS and PDU architecture. Enroll: https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/power-systems-electrical-fundamentals?buy=847

## Guides

- [Concurrent maintainability, in plain terms](https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/guides/concurrent-maintainability): What Tier III really asks for, and how operations teams use it.
- [Fault tolerance vs redundancy](https://dc-tiers.hazwoperosha.us/guides/fault-tolerance-vs-redundancy): Why Tier IV is more than 'more equipment'.
